items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 26 November 2026 10:30pm
items.description:
##Tomorrow##

Rain at first, but clearing during morning, leaving the rest of the day dry with sunny spells as winds fall light. Then a clear evening with a grass frost in places. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds at first. Coastal overtopping warning in place until 02:30, see warning for details. Heavy rain - risk of localised flooding.

##Saturday, 28 November 2026##

A cloudy but dry start to Saturday, then rain through afternoon, this clearing in evening. Strong southeast winds for a time, then max temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds for a time. Risk of coastal overtopping at high tide (~13:45).
